name: Aroe Aivel
source: A well known name around the magic community, Aroe Aivel is the most talanted magus in the academy. In spite of her cold and indifferent personality, she teams up with Cain in hopes of ending the game`s cycle for good. Her unshakable motive behind this objective lies in the secrets of her past. She`s the ruler of sea monster and gatekeeper of the abyss, Leviathan.
